basic_info.description: This beautiful three story home has striking curb appeal that captivates upon arrival. This home boasts an updated kitchen with a spacious deck with views, formal dining room, bright living room, and views of the ocean and Golden Gate Bridge from the bedroom. The ground level with its own separate entry is perfect for guest quarters, artist studio, home office, or entertaining. Conveniently located near 19th Ave, great for commuters to the South Bay. Near Stonestown Galleria Mall, parks, and restaurants. Come see this gem before it's gone!
